product.detailsText: Each print is produced on 210 gsm archival matte paper with a subtle textured finish, then hand-framed in our workshop. Frames use FSC-certified oak and shatterproof acrylic glazing.
product.shippingText: Free worldwide shipping on orders over $75. Prints are rolled in acid-free tissue and shipped in rigid tubes or protective crates. You have 30 days to return any piece — we'll even cover the return label.
product.materialsText: Dust frames with a soft dry cloth and keep out of direct sunlight to preserve colour. Canvas prints ship ready to hang with an anti-sag support system.
